name: Experiment Evaluation and Dataset Curation
description: Experiment filesystem discovery, evaluated artifact retrieval, and deduplicated curation into persistent diagram datasets.

codeEntities.label: ExperimentCatalog
codeEntities.summary: Reads experiment directories and exposes summarized experiments and individual generated artifacts.

codeEntities.label: summarize
codeEntities.summary: Combines the experiment manifest, project metadata, analyses, generations, and metrics into one summary.

codeEntities.label: ExperimentSummary
codeEntities.summary: Describes an experiment, its project, status, model, axes, and iteration summaries.

codeEntities.label: artifact
codeEntities.summary: Validates experiment coordinates and loads one generation record as a complete diagram artifact.

codeEntities.label: ExperimentDiagramArtifact
codeEntities.summary: Carries generated ASCII, CodeEntity IDs, metrics, prompt configuration, and model identity.

codeEntities.label: ExperimentViewerPage
codeEntities.summary: Loads experiment and dataset catalogs, presents evaluated artifacts, and initiates dataset curation actions.

codeEntities.label: DiagramDatasetStore
codeEntities.summary: Persists curated dataset collections and provides listing, insertion, labeling, and removal operations.

codeEntities.label: addItem
codeEntities.summary: Normalizes a curated item, deduplicates it by experiment source, and atomically persists the dataset.

codeEntities.label: DiagramDatasetItemRecord
codeEntities.summary: Stores a curated diagram's ASCII, evidence IDs, source coordinates, evaluation metrics, model, prompt, and labels.

codeEntities.label: DiagramDatasetRecord
codeEntities.summary: Defines the private persisted dataset document containing its metadata and curated items.

codeEntities.label: list
codeEntities.summary: Reads all dataset documents and returns summaries ordered by their latest update time.

codeEntities.label: updateLabels
codeEntities.summary: Normalizes and replaces labels on a selected dataset item, then atomically saves the collection.

codeEntities.label: removeItem
codeEntities.summary: Removes a selected item from its dataset and atomically saves the updated collection.

codeEntities.label: DiagramDatasetCatalogSnapshot
codeEntities.summary: Provides the UI-facing collection of diagram dataset summaries.
